description_en: Queries a list of nodes. Supports querying batch integration, real-time integration, and unstructured workflows (data aggregation, offline workflows, and real-time workflows). Supports multi-dimensional filtering by folder, keyword, node type, submit status, scheduling type, owner, label, creator, and more. Results are returned with pagination
description_zh: 查询任务列表，支持查询离线集成、实时集成和非结构化工作流（数据归集/离线工作流/实时工作流），支持按目录、关键字、任务类型、提交状态、调度类型、负责人、标签、创建人等多维过滤，结果分页返回
name: ListPipelines

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the operator
parameters.name: op_user_id

fields.help_en:
The environment identifier. Valid values:

DEV: development environment.
PROD: production environment.

Default value: PROD
fields.help_zh: 环境标识：DEV-开发环境，PROD（默认）-生产环境
fields.name: env

fields.help_en: The list of creator user IDs for filtering. If left empty, no filtering is applied. Multiple values are evaluated with an OR relationship
fields.help_zh: 创建人userId过滤，为空不过滤，多个为或关系
fields.name: creator_list

fields.help_en: The list of development owner user IDs for filtering. If left empty, no filtering is applied. Multiple values are evaluated with an OR relationship
fields.help_zh: 开发负责人userId过滤，为空不过滤，多个为或关系
fields.name: develop_owner_list

fields.help_en: The list of full folder paths to query. If left empty, the root folder is queried
fields.help_zh: 查询的目录全路径列表，为空则查询根目录
fields.name: directories

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to use exact match for node names. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 是否精确匹配任务名称，默认false
fields.name: exact_match

fields.help_en: The list of node name keywords. This parameter is optional. If left empty, no filtering by name is applied. For exact match, specify full names. For fuzzy match, specify keywords. Multiple values are evaluated with an OR relationship
fields.help_zh: 任务名称关键字列表（选填，为空则不按名称过滤）：精确匹配时为全名列表，模糊匹配时为关键字列表，多个为或关系
fields.name: keywords

fields.help_en: The cursor-based pagination parameter (an opaque cursor that callers do not need to interpret). This parameter is optional. If not specified, the request is treated as a first-page request and returns the actual total count. If specified, the request is treated as a subsequent-page request. Pass the NextCursor value returned from the previous page as-is. The SQL layer automatically filters by incrementing ID to query the next page without re-querying the total count. No OFFSET is used throughout, which avoids performance degradation in deep paging scenarios
fields.help_zh: 下一页游表，首页为空，非首页取上一页返回值的NextCursor
fields.name: next_cursor

fields.help_en: The list of O&M owner user IDs for filtering. If left empty, no filtering is applied. Multiple values are evaluated with an OR relationship
fields.help_zh: 运维负责人userId过滤，为空不过滤，多个为或关系
fields.name: ops_owner_list

fields.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. Pages start from 1
fields.name: page_num

fields.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
fields.help_zh: 分页每页大小，默认10，最大100
fields.name: page_size

fields.help_en:
The list of node types. Default value: [0] (batch integration). Valid values:

0: batch integration.
1: real-time integration.
13: data aggregation.
14: offline unstructured workflow.
15: real-time unstructured workflow.
16: online unstructured workflow.

If null or an empty list is passed, the default value [0] is used
fields.help_zh: 任务类型列表，默认[0]-离线集成：0-离线集成，1-实时集成，13-数据归集，14-离线非结构化工作流，15-实时非结构化工作流，16-在线非结构化工作流；传入null或空列表时兜底为默认值[0]
fields.name: pipeline_type_list

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to recursively query subfolders. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 是否递归查询子目录，默认false
fields.name: recursive

fields.help_en:
The list of scheduling types for filtering. If left empty, no filtering is applied. Valid values:

1: periodic scheduling.
3: manual scheduling.
5: real-time scheduling.
7: online workflow
fields.help_zh: 调度类型过滤，为空不过滤：1-周期调度，3-手动调度，5-实时调度，7-在线工作流
fields.name: schedule_type_list

fields.help_en:
The list of submit statuses for filtering. If left empty, no filtering is applied. Valid values:

DRAFT: draft.
SUBMITTING: submitting.
SUBMITTED: submitted.
PUBLISHED: published
fields.help_zh: 提交状态过滤，为空不过滤：DRAFT-草稿，SUBMITTING-提交中，SUBMITTED-已提交，PUBLISHED-已发布
fields.name: submit_status_list

fields.help_en: The list of label names for filtering. If left empty, no filtering is applied. Multiple values are evaluated with an OR relationship
fields.help_zh: 标签名称过滤，为空不过滤，多个为或关系
fields.name: tag_list

fields.help_en: The total number of records for cursor-based pagination. This parameter is optional and takes effect only when NextCursor is not empty. After the first-page request returns the actual total count, pass this value back as-is for subsequent pages. The server does not re-query the total count and directly echoes the value, which avoids redundant count overhead. If not specified, the system falls back to querying one extra record to determine whether a next page exists
fields.name: total_count

NextCursor.description_en: The cursor for the next page (an opaque cursor that the caller does not need to interpret). A null value indicates that there are no more pages. Otherwise, pass this value as the nextCursor parameter in the next request to retrieve the next page
NextCursor.description_zh: 游标分页下一页标识（不透明游标，调用方无需解读其含义）：为null表示已经没有下一页，否则将此值原样作为下一次请求的nextCursor传入即可继续获取下一页
NextCursor.title_en: 游标分页下一页标识（不透明游标，调用方无需解读其含义）：为null表示已经没有下一页，否则将此值原样作为下一次请求的nextCursor传入即可继续获取下一页
NextCursor.title_zh: 游标分页下一页标识（不透明游标，调用方无需解读其含义）：为null表示已经没有下一页，否则将此值原样作为下一次请求的nextCursor传入即可继续获取下一页

PageNum.description_en: The current page number, starting from 1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

Total.description_en: The total number of records that match the conditions. For the first page request, the actual total count is returned. For subsequent page requests (when nextCursor is passed in), if totalCount is included in the request, the same value is returned. Otherwise, this field is not returned. The total value is a snapshot taken at the time of the first page query and is not updated in real time as data changes during pagination
Total.title_en: 符合条件的总记录数：首页请求时返回实际总数；续页请求(传入nextCursor)时，若请求中传入了totalCount则原样回显，否则不返回该字段；total为首页查询时刻的快照值，不会随翻页期间数据变化实时更新
Total.title_zh: 符合条件的总记录数：首页请求时返回实际总数；续页请求(传入nextCursor)时，若请求中传入了totalCount则原样回显，否则不返回该字段；total为首页查询时刻的快照值，不会随翻页期间数据变化实时更新
